subject: Locking rates with phased prepay commitment — proposal and questions
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura@pipeline-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pipeline Analytics Legal <legal@pipeline-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: locking rate while we scale — initial ask

Karthik,

Thanks again for the partnership — our team has been very happy with latency and the cost profile, but with our growth forecast we need clarity on unit pricing for next year. We expect consumption to ramp from ~1.2B tokens/mo in Q2 to ~3.5B by Q4.

Two asks from our side as we approach renewal:
- Can Redwood lock current per-token rates for 24 months if we provide a multi-year prepay? We're open to a stepped ramp so we don't have to prepay all at once.
- What discount band and refund/credit mechanics exist if we under-utilize the prepay? Our CFO is sensitive to sunk commit.

We'd like to see a quick term sheet and a proposed payment schedule so we can brief finance. Attaching an initial forecast and the renewal calendar.

Best,
Laura
Laura Jensen
VP, Platform
Pipeline Analytics

Attachments: pipeline_forecast_q2-q4.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura@pipeline-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: locking rate while we scale — initial ask

Laura — really appreciate the clarity and the forecast. High level response before we get legal involved:

1) Yes — we can offer a 24-month rate lock through a multi-year prepay.
2) Recommendation: a three-stage prepay schedule tied to your expected ramp to balance cash impact and rate certainty. Example: 30% upfront (effective immediately), 40% at start of Q3, 30% at start of Q4. That maps to your forecast and gives us predictable capacity planning.
3) Discount: for a 24-month prepay we can offer a blended discount of 22% off list for the committed volume (tokens consumed up to committed amount). Additional consumption above commit will use a slightly higher on-demand uplift (we can cap that uplift).
4) Under-utilization: we prefer credit roll-forward (12 months) rather than refunds. Alternatively, a partial refund ladder (up to 20% of unused prepay returned in year 2) can be discussed for larger deals.

I'll attach a draft term sheet with the stepped schedule and proposed discount bands. If that looks reasonable, Marissa will support getting legal redlines and Ben can confirm the finance treatment for credits vs refunds.

Next steps: Can you confirm the phases you want covered by each tranche? If you want, we can model a conservative and aggressive ramp and show the net present value to Pipeline's CFO.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PA_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v1.xlsx (Excel, 95KB)
From: Laura Jensen <laura@pipeline-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pipeline Analytics Legal <legal@pipeline-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: locking rate while we scale — initial ask

Karthik — thanks, that's helpful. Two quick clarifying Qs from our CFO/legal:
- Early termination: if we hit a worse-than-expected macro and need to downsize, is there an option to convert prepaid dollars to a reduced committed amount with a fee, instead of full refund?
- Audit & usage reporting cadence: for credit roll-forward we need monthly certified usage reports and an audit window. Can Redwood provide token-level exports for reconciliation?

If you can confirm those, we can circulate the draft term sheet internally and come back with redlines.

Best,
Laura

On Mon, Feb 15, 2027 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Laura — really appreciate the clarity and the forecast. High level response before we get legal involved:
> ...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: locking rate while we scale — draft response & internal ops questions

Karthik / Ben / Vivek — forwarding Pipeline's clarifying questions from Laura. My suggested internal positions below so we can be aligned before sending the formal reply:

- Early termination: propose a conversion fee equal to 10% of remaining prepaid value to move to a reduced committed band (keeps some revenue protection while giving the customer flexibility). For >$500k remaining we could tier the fee down to 7%.
- Audit & reporting: Redwood can provide monthly token-level export (CSV) and a 30-day audit window. For large customers we can offer a secure S3 export and a standard reconciliation template.
- Credit roll-forward: allow 12 months of roll-forward; any unused after 12 months will be forfeited unless negotiate an exception tied to macro clauses.

Ben — can you confirm accounting: with conversion fee as revenue, do we need to treat credits differently vs refunds for ASC606 recognition?
Vivek — can you validate the ramp schedule mapping to their forecast and confirm capacity commitments?

If everyone signs off, I'll draft the formal response and attach contract_draft_v3.pdf with our proposed legal language for the conversion fee and reporting obligations.

Thanks — Marissa
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: contract_draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 145KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jensen <laura@pipeline-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 17:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: locking rate while we scale — proposal and next steps

Laura — looping back with a concise proposal after internal alignment. Summary of the commercial terms we're prepared to offer: 

- Term: 24 months rate lock on committed tokens.
- Structure: Three-tranche prepaid schedule (30% upfront, 40% start Q3, 30% start Q4). Tranches map to forecast worksheet.
- Discount: 22% blended on committed token bands. Consumption above commit billed at list + 8% uplift (capped at 12% over list).
- Under-utilization: 12-month credit roll-forward. Unused credits after 12 months forfeited unless a macro clause is invoked.
- Early conversion: option to convert prepaid dollars to a smaller committed band with a conversion fee equal to 10% of remaining prepaid value (7% if >$500k remaining).
- Reporting: monthly token-level CSV exports and a secure S3 feed for reconciliation; 30-day audit window.

Attached: final term sheet (PA_Renewal_Term_Sheet_v1.xlsx), redlines summary (redlines_from_pipeline_legal.docx), and the legal contract draft (contract_draft_v3.pdf). If that aligns, we will issue a DocuSign envelope for signature and coordinate the payment schedule with finance.

Next actions for Pipeline: confirm tranche dates and sign authorization to start invoice schedule. For Redwood: Marissa will issue the contract and Ben will set up the invoice & accounting workflow.

Link to sign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/PA-4872-sign
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/PA-2027-4872

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked in.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
